purpose: Define the review-only residual-emitter record required before any candidate atomic predictive-v1 residual rows can be promoted into accepted delta_uet_or_ci provenance.

required_checks.requirement: The review record points to the current residual artifact and the current diagnostic emitter state.
A runtime residual artifact exists and exports row-level residuals for the current lane.
Every emitted row remains explicitly diagnostic rather than silently accepted as delta_uet_or_ci output.
Residual rows stay linked to locked review-only parameters and the holdout-exclusion policy.
The record still states that the residual emitter is not accepted, so diagnostic residual rows cannot be confused with accepted provenance.

blocked_claims: diagnostic residual rows may be relabeled as accepted delta_uet_or_ci output
runtime residual export alone means an accepted operator exists
review-only residual rows may be cited as validation-ready operator evidence
claim_boundary: This manifest defines a review-only residual-emitter record. It does not accept or validate delta_uet_or_ci.
